name: Data / BI Agents
description: Metrics, lineage, and certification vocabulary + starter questions.
starter_prompts: Which metrics are certified vs draft in our catalog?
Trace the lineage of the revenue metric to its source tables
Which dashboards use stale data sources (no refresh in 7 days)?

terminology.description: A metric definition reviewed and approved by an owner — safe for exec reporting.
The path data takes from source to report — the backbone of trust.
Business-language mapping over physical data. In this platform, that IS the ontology.
How recently source data was updated — surfaced in TrustPanel on answers.
Mined query patterns that improve NL2SQL planning (this platform mines them automatically).
An unmanaged duplicate of an official metric — the #1 source of conflicting numbers.
